messages:
maria: Heads up — planning a staggered node drain+reboot in us-east1 for a kernel micropatch. Target window Wed 02:00-06:00 UTC. We'll do cohorts of ~5 nodes (≈40 GPUs) every 20m to keep tail latency stable.

sam: How much capacity do we expect to lose at peak during the handoff?

maria: Roughly 8–10% raw GPU capacity while a cohort is draining, but we'll pace so 99p latency stays within SLO. Canaries first: rack-3 -> rack-7.

taylor: Any cost hit from burst backfill or cross-region routing? We should surface to finance.

maria: Expect ~1.2k USD extra for on-demand overflow if eu/us fallback kicks in for the full 4h. Worst-case short spikes might add another ~300. We'll attempt to avoid overflow by throttling low-priority tenants.

rui: Please add the runbook snippet here so oncall can follow.

maria: Copy of drain steps for ops runbook:

```
# cordon and drain with eviction grace tuning
kubectl cordon gpu-node-###
kubectl drain gpu-node-### --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --pod-selector=tenant!=priority --grace-period=120
# mark kv cache seed job after drain completes
kubectl apply -f kvcache-seed-job.yaml --namespace=runtime
```

maria: Key notes: set --pod-selector to avoid disrupting priority tenants, use grace-period 120 to let graceful shutdowns finish, and run KV cache preseed on replacement nodes immediately.

sam: Can we enforce one cohort per AZ to avoid cross-AZ egress pressure? Last time we hit egress caps.

maria: Yes — updated plan: cohorts scoped to AZs (us-east1-a then -b then -c). apac-edge and eu pools are excluded from this maintenance.

taylor: Tenant throttling plan? Who owns the policy table?
maria: Devex will apply tenant throttles via the routing policy for the window: set weight=0.2 for non-prod, weight=0.5 for low-priority prod. @taylor pls confirm policy applies by Tue EOD.

taylor: Ack, will publish the routing change and include the cost estimate in the weekly spend note.

eng-oncall-bot: Scheduled maintenance created: us-east1 kernel micropatch, start=1712445600 (Wed 02:00 UTC), end=1712460000 (Wed 06:00 UTC), cohorts=~5 nodes every 20m. Pager escalations unchanged.

ops: We'll post a status page banner and email Dedicated customers with impacted capacity numbers (8–10% and potential overflow estimate). I'll also add a short blurb for the customer-facing release notes.

rui: One more operational ask: please run a KV-seed smoke check after the first two cohorts complete and validate generator latency at 10k token prefix. If it looks off, pause the rollout.

maria: Good call — adding a smoke-check gate after cohort-2. Pause window included in schedule.

sam: If anything odd shows up, what's the rollback?
maria: Rollback is to stop further drains, uncordon the last drained nodes if under threshold, and route traffic back to stable region variants. Full rollback playbook in the runbook doc.

taylor: I put the estimated cost and who to bill in #finance later.

maria: Final checklist for tomorrow: confirm canary rack health, update routing weights, publish status page, runbook link in the thread, and ops to send customer emails.

ops: Will do. ETA for customer emails: Tue 18:00 UTC.

sam: :thumbsup:

taylor: :thumbsup:

rui: adding runbook link in comments (internal doc)

maria: Thanks all — we'll keep the thread updated with any changes.
